config.note: single shared model with role/pos one-hots beat 3 role-specific models (~51-52)
text_features: forum char_wb (2,5)-grams, min_df=2, sublinear_tf (key for 57% unseen test forums)
config.dense_features: 90-dim StandardScaler'd basis from common.extract_nodes: role/pos/route_len, depth/gaps/view stats, par_kind+par_type one-hots, kid/desc/sib type counts+fractions over 6 vis types, between-chain types, thread vis-type distribution, terminal flag, title flags, profile flags
config.oof: 5-fold common.make_folds (seed 42), vectorizers+scaler fit per-fold on train side only (no leakage)
config.test: mean of the 5 fold models' predict_proba on test

hpo_findings.class_weight: balanced beats none on viterbi TypeMacroF1 (0.466 vs 0.439); none gives slightly better AnchorMacroF1 under posterior
hpo_findings.role_specific: worse than single shared model everywhere
hpo_findings.enrichment_tried_and_rejected: forum word-unigram tokens + pos0/anchor interaction terms + extra dense (105-dim) slightly HURT (~52.8); geomean(balanced,none) blend lifts AnchorMacroF1 (0.439) but not total (best 53.13, ties). Original 90-dim + 3 vectorizers is the family optimum.
hpo_findings.weak_classes: agreement (F1 0.325) and appreciation (0.352) are the macro-F1 bottleneck; elaboration weak specifically at anchor (0.259)
